caption:
You keep adding "one more thing." Is grace really not enough? Add anything to the gospel and it's not a better one — it's a different one. (Galatians 1:6-7 devotional)

Grace plus anything stops being grace — it becomes a different gospel wearing the same name. The “one more thing” you keep adding isn't a bonus; it's the door out, away from the God who called you. Jesus already filled that blank completely on the cross, so there is nothing left for you to add.
